name: Obsidian Clock
author: austrasien (fork of Omarchy clock)
description: Date/time label with a calendar popup and Obsidian daily journal

barWidget.description: Date/time label with a clickable calendar and daily journal

schema.label: Obsidian vault path
schema.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault. Set this after install (omarchy bar set, or vaultPath on the widget in shell.json). Daily notes follow .obsidian/daily-notes.json.

schema.label: Journal backend binary
schema.description: Optional absolute path to obsidian-daily-qs. Leave empty to auto-detect an installed austraz.obsidian-daily plugin or a binary on PATH.
